hypotheses.construction_plan: Start from the parameterized diagonal template M(theta, theta). Substitute theta=1 to obtain M(1, 1), and substitute theta=2 to obtain M(2, 2).
required_assumptions: M is a two-argument function and both observed calls are instances of the diagonal template M(theta, theta).
hypotheses.rationale: The two non-identical calls share the same function name M and the same diagonal argument structure, differing only by the repeated numeric value. The observed LGG template is M(theta0, theta0), supporting a single parameterized diagonal family.
